name: Kesmark test range
description: The Kesmark district of the Pannonian theatre as a 40 by 40 km map: the river Rava and the Kesmark bridges battery 21 defends, the town, five villages, farmsteads, the Lazne woods and the Dubnik forest, the regiment's and the division's posts, the radar post above Polany, the S-125 at Kecel and the Kecel air base. Ground beyond the map runs out to 150 km so aircraft coming from the borders fly over land.
source: game value: positions from data/air_war/theatre_pannonia.json and data/command/places_pannonia.json; shapes, sizes and counts are sam3d estimates
notes: Fictional. Positions in km east and north of the theatre's origin, sizes in metres, headings true. Everything here is presentation and ground for line of sight; nothing is system data. The map's own frame is the theatre's (origin below); a scenario with another origin sees the same ground through MapTerrain, converted through the Earth-centred frame. Ultra low detail by design: every building, wood and site is a few boxes.

airspace.notes: Aircraft may fly anywhere: the air war's border entries lie 100-185 km out. The weather (data/weather/) covers the whole airspace.

valley.notes: The Rava's valley, carved along the river.

detail.notes: Battery 21's district (its position at 6.4, -9.6 and both Kesmark bridges inside): 10 m ground with a little micro relief (roadmap R6). Its edges are nodes of the map proper's 50 m ground.
The capital (data/maps/pannonia.json settlements.capital, radius 7 km) and the dynamic campaign test round it: 20 m ground (roadmap R6). Its edges are nodes of the far ground's 500 m ground.

detail_settlements.name: The capital
detail_settlements.notes: Laid out in the capital's detail area on its own random stream, its streets along the country's roads through it (roadmap R6). The id is the country's (pannonia.json settlements.capital). The count is a game value: the blocks grid holds about 34000 lots.

farmsteads.notes: Tanyas: lone farmsteads on the plain, inside the map only.

farmland.notes: game values, sam3d estimates (docs/scenery/T3_T4_PLAN.md): the plain in estates of 4 km, each a collective farm's fields of 84-200 ha (a TSZ's, 100-200 ha, 1970s-80s; docs/research/TERRAIN_REFERENCES_2026-11.md) in rows along one heading; farm tracks (dulout) along half the fields' long sides, tree rows (12-22 m, poplar and locust) along 30 percent of them and 50 percent of the main and secondary roads, a grove round three sides of each tanya. None within 600 m of a site, nor 2 km of an Osa or dummy position (its launchers stand up to a kilometre out and its crews fell what masks the antennas; docs/air_war/09_BALANCE.md section 13). Rows and groves block sight (they are boxes of the map).

woods.notes: Woods are canopy blocks: one box per block, its top the canopy height.
